name: network.mintex.module_kyc.ui.activity.CaptureDocumentFrontResultActivity
description: After the user photographs the front of an ID card or driver license, the Verifybloc KYC SDK shows the image here for a readability check. Accepting it saves the photo and advances to the back-side or face-check step as required.
disableEffect: The user cannot review and confirm the front of the identity document, which can stop the KYC application.
